exceptions.reason: Every version of extract-zip is affected (range *), so there is no upgrade to take and no override that resolves it. It arrives only as a transitive dependency of @wordpress/scripts, through @wordpress/e2e-test-utils-playwright -> lighthouse -> puppeteer-core -> @puppeteer/browsers, where its single job is unpacking the Chromium archive puppeteer downloads. Nothing in this repository imports lighthouse, puppeteer or e2e-test-utils-playwright: the browser suite drives @playwright/test directly and Playwright installs its own browsers. The package is installed and never executed.
exceptions.control: The advisory is a symlink path traversal in an extracted archive, so it needs an attacker-supplied zip. The only archive this path would ever open is a Chromium build fetched from Google's CDN by a code path this repository does not call. It is a devDependency, so it reaches no WordPress site: scripts/build-shared-host-dist.mjs ships plugin and theme source, never node_modules. Pull-request CI runs with a read-only token and no production secrets.
exceptions.upstreamTrigger: Remove when @puppeteer/browsers depends on a fixed extract-zip (none exists as of 2026-09-04; latest 2.0.1 is affected), or when @wordpress/scripts drops the lighthouse and puppeteer chain from @wordpress/e2e-test-utils-playwright.
